stem: Northstar Logistics keeps configuration split across several nested module subdirectories, and an engineer wants every file in the whole tree rewritten to canonical style in one command. Which flag accomplishes that?

choices.text: leave off any flag, which only reaches the current directory

rationale: -recursive processes files in subdirectories in addition to the current directory, covering the whole tree in one command. -check only reports formatting status without rewriting anything. Leaving off the flag reaches only the current directory, missing the nested subdirectories entirely. validate checks correctness, not style, and rewrites nothing at all.
